detail.longDescription: I'm constantly seeing posts about how "AI is already better than humans", "programmers are useless" "everything can be vibe-coded by someone with 0 technical experience". Is everyone online just that bad at programming? I didn't believe software could get any worse than what was already being put out, but since the adoption of AI I have been proven wrong. Every vibe-coded software I've used has been ass, but these people swear that it's the best thing ever. Where are they coming from?
